claims.text: The printed record of the House Oversight Task Force on the Declassification of Federal Secrets hearing of 9 September 2025 carries this colloquy. Rep. Eric Burlison: 'Madam Chair, I also have further witnesses of courageous individuals. It was given to me by Dr. Steven Greer, including Michael Herrera and his testimony. We have Roderick Castle and his testimony; Randy Anderson, his testimony; Steven Digna, and others, three others, all saying similar things to what the witnesses today have said, and I would like to enter that into the record as well.' Chairwoman Luna: 'No objection.' What this documents is that a member moved a document about him into a hearing record and sourced it to Steven Greer. It does not document that he testified, was sworn, or appeared.

He is on no congressional witness list. The committee-published witness lists for 26 July 2023 (event 116282), 13 November 2024 (event 117722) and 9 September 2025 name him nowhere, and the printed records of all three hearings contain his name exactly once in total, in the Burlison colloquy.

label: Michael Herrera
narrative: Michael Herrera is a claimant whose account has reached two official records without him ever having testified, and the distinction is the whole reason this node is carefully worded. He has never been a witness at a congressional hearing. His name appears exactly once across the printed records of the three modern House UAP hearings: on 9 September 2025 Rep. Eric Burlison moved a document about him into the record, describing it as testimony given to him by Dr. Steven Greer, and the chair admitted it without objection. Separately, AARO's Historical Record Report Volume I carries at page 29 an anonymised one-sentence summary of a 2009 foreign humanitarian-mission account that matches his public account on year, mission type and scene. AARO names nobody and maintains the anonymisation key itself, so the identification of that interviewee as Herrera is an inference and is carried here as Tier 3, not as a fact. His own account is on the public record in a dated artefact, a Shawn Ryan Show appearance of 17 July 2023. No service record, no DD-214 and no corroborating squadmate was opened. What makes him a node is proximity to a claim that two official records touch, not credibility: he held no programme office and no clearance is documented anywhere.
